newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended Feb. 5 rose to $945.09 billion from $933.62 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 654 retail money market mutual funds rose $2.66 billion to $628.87 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 395 taxable money market funds rose $818.1 million to $512.02 billion, while assets of the 259 tax-exempt funds rose $1.84 billion to $116.86 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 319 institutional money market funds rose $8.81 billion to $316.21 billion. Of these, assets of the 256 taxable money market funds increased $7.19 billion to $283.79 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds grew $1.62 billion to $32.42 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets total to $933.62 billion from $933.67 billion.
